name: Dragon Knight
pitch: A kind young knight-in-training sets out to meet the dragon everyone is afraid of and discovers it is just shy and lonely.
setting: The Kingdom of Applebright, with a hilltop castle, patchwork fields, a misty mountain, and a cave full of glittering crystals

supportingCast.name: Ember
supportingCast.look: small round dragon with lavender scales, tiny wings, and puffs of pink smoke when nervous

supportingCast.name: Sir Bramble
supportingCast.look: an old, cheerful knight with a big white mustache and slightly rusty armor

supportingCast.name: Hazel
supportingCast.look: fluffy chestnut pony with a braided mane and ribbons

contentRules: swords only as costume props, never used

starters.title: The Dragon's Birthday
starters.idea: Everyone in the castle is afraid of Ember, who keeps the kingdom's lanterns lit. The knights try to sneak past and the cook sends a cake by catapult, which goes wrong. The child walks up and asks Ember's name, learns it is Ember's birthday and no one ever came, and the whole kingdom throws a lantern party.

starters.title: Ember Loses Her Roar
starters.idea: Ember wakes with no fire and no roar on the night of the Winter Lights. Sir Bramble's warm potion and Hazel's galloping race don't bring it back. The child realizes Ember is simply nervous and sings their favorite song with her; her laugh turns into a warm glow that lights every lantern.
